topic: Naruto didn't defeat Gaara with strength; he reached him because he recognized Gaara's loneliness
title: Naruto Didn't Beat Gaara, He Recognized Him
description: Gaara loved only himself until Naruto, the one other jinchuriki who knew that loneliness, got through to him in the Konoha Crush fight. Here's why the headbutt wasn't what changed him. Did Gaara change because he was understood, or because he lost?
comment: Did Gaara change because Naruto understood him, or because he finally lost a fight?

lines.text: Naruto didn't beat Gaara. He recognized him.

shot.fallback: blond ninja boy facing a red haired boy, sand swirling

lines.text: And I think that's the real reason Gaara changed.

shot.fallback: red haired ninja boy with sand gourd

lines.text: Gaara grew up in a village where adults avoided him and children ran.

shot.fallback: lonely boy in a desert village, villagers keeping away

lines.text: So he scarred the kanji for love into his own head.

shot.fallback: red haired boy carving a symbol into his forehead

lines.text: But it was never love for anyone else. It was love for himself alone.

shot.fallback: boy with dark rimmed eyes and a red symbol on his forehead

lines.text: In the Chunin Exams he said lonely eyes long for strength, and he hunted anyone who had them.

shot.search: Gaara Chunin Exams Forest of Death
shot.fallback: sand ninja hunting rivals in a dark forest

lines.text: Then Konoha Crush hits, and Shukaku comes out.

shot.fallback: giant sand raccoon monster towering over a village

lines.text: Naruto's headbutt shatters Shukaku's body, and by chapter 138 both of them are flat on the ground.

shot.fallback: blond ninja headbutting a red haired boy, sand exploding

lines.text: Naruto doesn't talk down to him. He says he knows that loneliness, and he'll stop him if he hurts his friends.

shot.fallback: two exhausted ninja boys lying on the ground

lines.text: People say Gaara changed because he lost.

shot.fallback: defeated red haired ninja boy on the ground

lines.text: But losing doesn't fix loneliness. Being understood does.

shot.fallback: two boys looking at each other, sunlit sky

lines.text: Naruto showed him strength can come from protecting others, and years later Gaara is Kazekage.

shot.fallback: red haired Kage in white hat standing over a village
blond ninja boy facing a red haired boy, sand swirling

self_check.hook: claim in line 1 names Naruto and Gaara

published.comment: Did Gaara change because Naruto understood him, or because he finally lost a fight?
